scope: To probe the potential role of AXIN1, we performed proteomic mass spectrometry analysis in AXIN1-KO and control THP-1 cells.

A total of 5x106 vector control or Axin1-KO THP_1 andHepa1-6 cell lines were cultured in T-25 cm2 flasks, harvested.washed three times with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS). To examine AXIN1-regulated global protein expression changes, we generated Axin1-KO Hepa1-6 cells (Supplementary Fig. 11a), and then performed mass spectrometry proteomic analysis.
